Hi Carlos - quick answers before the demo so we can make the meeting high-signal: 

- For the 60% short-chat traffic at ~250 req/sec (256-token upper bound), we typically recommend a quantization profile that preserves FP16 kernels for attention and uses 4-bit weight quantization for transformer weights where latency is critical. That balances model size and kernel efficiency.
- Batching: real-time routing at 250 rps works best with micro-batching windows (2-5ms) + continuous batching on the serving runtime. That gives high throughput while keeping p95/p99 within SLOs.
- Caching: prefix/KV cache for repeated conversation prefixes will cut token compute by ~20-40% depending on repetition.
- Hardware: for p99 <200ms at 250 rps for short sequences, we'd typically recommend a dedicated pool sized for concurrency (N replicas sized for target throughput) - we'll bring concrete perf numbers in the demo based on your questionnaire.

Attached is a short pre-demo checklist and a sample perf-sheet we can walk through. Looking forward to the call.

- Aditya
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
